dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What a great mindset you have. If anyone ever called me anything less than a genius, I'd be furious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon is tempted to give it a shot... Eeek! Mona is glaring at me!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Paimon, there's a difference between embracing the spirit of rock 'n' roll and playing with fire...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I'm also starting to develop an interest in rock 'n' roll.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Seriously? This'd better not be a joke.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: No, I'm serious. Rock 'n' roll's ability to cultivate such a strong will in people is an incredible thing.
